proposed_comments.title: Serialize manifest copy and index generation across launches
proposed_comments.body:
### Serialize manifest copy and index generation across launches

**Severity:** `high`

Treating every `IOException` as a malformed manifest can publish an incomplete index during normal concurrent startup. `ShortcutGuide.Ui/Program.cs` starts copying and generation before registering the single application instance, so another launch can be writing a valid manifest while this process sees a sharing violation, skips that file, and becomes the last writer. Register the application instance before starting the copy/generation thread, or add an interprocess lock around the copy-and-generation sequence, so transient sharing failures cannot permanently omit valid shortcuts.

confidence.rationale: The latest fork Copilot pass independently identified this race on the current review tree; moving single-instance registration ahead of startup work fixed it in the fork, and the exact upstream head builds successfully before the proposed change.
